ownershipCoverage.rule: Main players are those projected above 0 points who are not listed out; a source is used when the players it names hold at least 80% of their total projected points.

recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. A player no ticked source covers has no projection: it is left blank, flagged "no projection" (0 when the injury report lists him out, on IR, doubtful or suspended); his DraftKings average per game never stands in.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

rows.name: Ja'Marr Chase

injury.comment: Chase caught 10 of 12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.
injury.longComment: The superstar wideout hit the ground running in Madrid, capping Cincinnati's first drive with a 47-yard touchdown catch from Joe Burrow. It was Chase's fourth straight game getting into the end zone, a stretch in which he's delivered a stellar 32-435-4 line on 45 targets, and Sunday's 155 receiving yards were a season high. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 10 during a crucial AFC North battle against the Steelers.

rows.name: Joe Burrow

injury.comment: Burrow completed 24 of 29 passes for 271 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons. He added seven yards and a TD on three carries.
injury.longComment: It was a nearly flawless performance from Burrow, as he hit Ja'Marr Chase for a 47-yard score in the first quarter and tossed a pair of shorter TDs to Tee Higgins later in the contest. The superstar QB also got into the end zone on a goal-line sneak in the second quarter. It's the fourth straight game in which Burrow has produced at least four touchdowns, an incredible stretch in which he's completed 77.0 percent of his passes for 1,215 yards with a 16:3 TD:INT plus two more scores on the ground. The Bengals, not coincidentally, are 4-0 in that span. Burrow will look to stay locked in for a big AFC North clash against the Steelers in Week 10.

rows.name: Jaylen Warren

injury.comment: Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
injury.longComment: Warren tied his single-game career high in rushing yards with Sunday's performance, which was partly fueled by a season-long 51-yard run. Warren now has back-to-back 100-yard efforts on the ground for the first time this season, and he snapped a brief two-game rushing TD drought Sunday with a one-yard run early in the third quarter that closed out the scoring for the afternoon. Warren is already up to 704 rushing yards on a career-best 5.9 yards per carry heading into a Week 9 road showdown against the Bengals on Sunday, Nov. 15, following a Week 8 bye.

rows.name: Aaron Rodgers

injury.comment: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Jaylen Warren spearheaded the Steelers' attack with 143 rushing yards and a touchdown, and backfield mate Rico Dowdle added 56 yards and a score of his own. When combined with a highly effective effort by Pittsburgh's defense, there wasn't much production required of Rodgers and the air attack after much busier games leading into Sunday. Rodgers finished with season-low figures in completions, pass attempts, completion percentage and passing yards while failing to throw a touchdown pass for the first time since Week 2, but he's highly likely to revert to his prior pass-heavy ways in a Week 10 road showdown against the Bengals on Sunday night, Nov. 15, following a Week 8 bye.
